objective: After C88/C89 own-scratch preservation, test fresh host and ancestor capacity for the E18 session numeric bridge without loading the model.
sampling: 60 s at 1 Hz, maximum gap 1.5 s; use minimum MemAvailable and external variation in existing host_resource_policy.
pass_rule: Existing policy cap_max_bytes >= requested cap, coherent sensors/power/storage/ancestors, no concurrent 120B process. A pass permits only a later separate bounded model admission.
fail_rule: If cap_max is below E18 or inventory is incomplete, preserve nonadmission and do not load model or silently lower cap.
